title: Canonical IDs as Primary Keys
core_map: state label -> canonical ID -> normalized transitions -> quotient partition
invariant: Every state and action is keyed by canonical encoding; successor references resolve only to existing canonical state IDs.
limitations: Not yet a drop-in migration of the older certificate API.
Observation/property payload equality semantics require a documented normalization contract.
Tests have not been independently executed.
next_rung: CXLXIX: differential equivalence testing between canonical-ID quotient and legacy quotient on generated collision-free models.
